tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Body text is `ink`; secondary text `ink-2` or `muted`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, and the chart plot area, on `ground`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells and table headers set into a `surface`.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: The glass-pane tint: GlassPanel fill, hover washes, selected rows. Text on it is `ink`, `ink-2`, or `forest`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, card borders, chart gridlines. Decorative only; never the only cue.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of form controls and anything that must be seen (3:1 on `surface` and `ground`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `ground`, `surface`, `glass`, and `forest-tint`.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and dense body copy on `ground`, `surface`, and `glass`. Also the true-skill reference line in charts.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, axis labels, timestamps, on `ground`, `surface`, and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Brand primary, forest green: primary buttons, links, focus rings, the mark's ground. As text on `ground`, `surface`, `glass`, `forest-tint`.

tokens.name: forest-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `forest` fills.

tokens.name: forest-tint
tokens.usage: Selected states and soft brand backgrounds; text on it is `ink` or `forest`.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `forest` and `forest-strong` fills.

tokens.name: earth
tokens.usage: Brand secondary, earthy brown: marketing bands, illustration blocks, the nonprofit's own voice (charter, governance, donations). Text on it is `on-earth`. Not a status color.

tokens.name: on-earth
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `earth` fills (6.6:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Brand third, deep blue: hero bands, footers, data and transparency moments. Text on it is `on-deep`. Not a status color.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `deep` fills (11.5:1 light, 5.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: ball
tokens.usage: Pickleball yellow highlight: the rating line in the mark, one callout or key number per view. A fill only; never text on light grounds (1.5:1). Text on it is `ball-ink`.

tokens.name: ball-ink
tokens.usage: Text and marks on `ball` fills.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: A rating going up: DeltaChip up. Always with a + sign and an up arrow; never color alone.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: A rating going down: DeltaChip down, and form errors. Always with a minus sign and a down arrow. Teal/orange keeps up and down distinct for color-blind readers, and apart from the green brand.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element (3:1 or better on every surface).

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (GlassRank in comparisons). Categorical order is fixed: 1 blue, 2 orange, 3 aqua, 4 yellow (a validated color-blind-safe order).

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (the comparison system, e.g. plain Elo).

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4. Pair with direct labels; below 3:1 on light grounds.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing-page hero headline only. One per page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Page and panel titles in the app.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Every rating change comes with a receipt that shows what happened and why.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Won 2 of 3 games; the ratings expected about 1.4.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Help text, table cells, receipt details.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and form labels; set uppercase.

styles.name: rating-xl
styles.usage: The one hero rating on a player page.

styles.name: rating
styles.usage: Ratings in lists, badges, and receipts.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Deltas, scores, and numbers in tables (tabular figures).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between tight siblings.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, list row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections in the app.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Marketing section spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, chart bar ends.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and glass panes; the logo mark's corner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Delta chips and toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, dialogs, and the floating sandbox panel. Cards use a `line` border instead.
